headline: Australia's NextDC Shares Fall After Community Opposition Stalls Grid Upgrade
summary: Shares of Australia's NextDC fell 42% after community opposition stalled a grid upgrade, forcing the company to pause new data center projects and land acquisitions.
why: Infrastructure bottlenecks and local opposition can delay high-growth capital projects, directly impacting expected revenue streams for tech and utility operators.
